ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that the graph of the inverse proportion function \(y_{1}=\frac{k}{x}\) and the graph of the linear function \(y_{2}=x+b\) intersect at point \(A(1, 4)\) and point \(B(-4, n)\). Directly write out the range of values of the independent variable \(x\) when \(y_{2}>y_{1}\).
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} When $-4 < x < 0$ or $x > 1$, we have $y_{2} > y_{1}$.

We directly express the range of the independent variable $x$ as \boxed{x \in (-4, 0) \cup (1, +\infty)}.
